messages.content: You identify patterns in complete email texts. Respond with valid JSON.

Please write a BRIEF 15-20 word executive summary of the theme "Information Provision" as it appears in the following examples.
['We recently reviewed your account and suspect that your Bank of America account might have been accessed by an unauthorized...', "We've noticed some errors in the login details of some of our internet banking users, which shows that you are one of the customers listed.", 'THE ECONOMIC AND FINANCIAL CRIMES COMMISSION FCC HAS DETECTED FROM THERE DATA BASE YOU HAVE BEEN SCAMMED BY SOME FRAUDULENT PEOPLE HERE IN NIGERIA.', 'Be informed that your package shall be delivered on Friday through the courier service.', 'You have 2 unread message(s)...', 'This message originated from eBay. eBay sent this message to confirm the transaction is active.', 'This e-mail has been sent to you by LLOYDS TSB inform you that we were unable to verify your account details.', 'We are running a scheduled maintenance on our servers.', "Methought you'd like to know that serendipity shipped your item, and that this completes your order.", 'Your order has been successfully canceled.', 'Your account, has been disabled for security reasons!', 'Your internet access has been suspended due to many unsuccessful login attempt.', "We've noticed some errors in your contact information.", 'Hello Your CORNELL UNIVERSITY network account password will expire in 3 days.', 'After the last annual calculations of your fiscal activity we have determined that you are eligible to receive a tax refund under section 501(c) (3) of the HM Revenue & Customs.', 'The Faster Payments Service, which launched on 27 May 2008, is a UK Banking industry initiative allowing participating Banks to provide real time processing of electronic payments such as funds transfers, bill payments and Standing Orders in June 2008.', 'We are sending you this email after a successful login to your PayPal account.']

DO NOT write the summary as a third party using terms like "the text examples" or "they discuss", but write the summary from the perspective of the text authors making the points directly.
Please respond ONLY with a valid JSON in the following format:
{
    "summary": "<SUMMARY>"
}

content: {"summary": "We provide updates about account security, service changes, transactions, deliveries, messages, and financial matters, often alerting you to issues or required actions."}
